long_biography.plain_text:
Grundy joined the business founded by his father, James Adams Grundy Sr., after earlier work outside the agency. Starting in sales and marketing during the 1980s, he helped transform a five-person family operation into a larger specialist firm and greatly expanded its collector-vehicle programme.

Now the company’s second-generation leader, Grundy works with three of his children in operating roles. Josh, Sam and Gwen represent a third generation at the agency, overseeing functions that include operations, marketing and personal lines. That continuity has preserved the firm’s family-business structure while broadening the team responsible for its growth.

James Caldwell Grundy Jr. was an American politician and businessman who lived from March 22, 1923 until May 2, 2020. 

Grundy was born in the Kentucky town of Lebanon. He attended Lebanon public schools before enrolling at the University of Kentucky. In Marion County, Kentucky, Grundy was a businessman. From 1956 to 1958, Grundy was a member of the Kentucky House of Representatives and was active in the Republican Party, chairing the Marion County Republican Committee from 1960 to 1970. On May 2, 2020, he passed away in Lebanon, Kentucky.
